articles.title: Decisive Dividend Corporation Announces $8.0 Million Non-Brokered Private Placement and Early Warning Report
articles.mainIdea: Decisive Dividend Corporation Announces $8.0 Million Non-Brokered Private Placement and Early Warning Report
articles.summary: CNW Group: Decisive Dividend Corporation Announces $8.0 Million Non-Brokered Private Placement and Early Warning Report. Decisive Dividend Corporation (TSXV: DE) ("Decisive" or the "Corporation") is pleased to announce that it has closed a non-brokered private placement of an aggregate of 1,065,000 common shares of Decisive ("Common Shares") at an issue price of $7.51 per Common Share resulting in gross proceeds to Decisive of $8.0 million (the "Private Placement"). Related tickers mentioned: DE.V.
